config.emi.tooltip.world.biome_pages:
Adds the Biome category: one page per biome with climate, tags, dimensions, mobs, structures and ores.
Needs an EMI reload.
config.emi.tooltip.world.structure_pages:
Adds the Structure category: one page per structure with dimensions, biomes, generation step, spacing and chest loot.
Needs an EMI reload.
config.emi.tooltip.world.structures_in_i:
Adds all structures to the EMI index so that they can be searched.
Needs the structure pages and an EMI reload.
config.emi.tooltip.world.icon_rows: How many rows of icons a section of a page (mobs, structures, ores, biomes) shows before the "+N" cell. 1 to 4.
config.emi.tooltip.world.max_loot_links:
How many chest loot links a structure page lists before "+N more". 0 hides them. Needs the loot module.
Needs an EMI reload.
emi_world.no_data.mobs: no spawn data from the server
emi_world.no_data.ores: no ore data from the server
emi_world.biome.temperature.hint: Below 0.15 precipitation falls as snow and water freezes; it gets colder with height.
emi_world.biome.downfall.tooltip: How wet the biome is. It also changes the colour of grass and leaves.
emi_world.biome.precipitation.tooltip: What falls from the sky at sea level, worked out from the temperature.
emi_world.biome.has_precipitation.toolti: Whether the biome has rain or snow at all (has_precipitation in the biome data).
emi_world.structure.dimensions.none: none (no biome of its dimension fits)
emi_world.structure.step.tooltip: The world generation step the structure is placed in.
emi_world.structure.set.tooltip: Structure set %s. One of its structures is picked for every placement, by weight: this one has %s of %s.
emi_world.structure.placement.none.toolt: No structure set places this structure: something else does, for example a feature or a command.
emi_world.structure.placement.other.tool: The structure set uses a placement type that another mod added.
emi_world.structure.spacing.tooltip: The world is divided into squares of this many chunks (1 chunk = 16 blocks). Every square can hold one structure.
emi_world.structure.separation.tooltip: A structure is never placed in the last chunks of its square, so neighbouring structures are at least this many chunks (%s blocks) apart.
emi_world.structure.spread.linear: Linear spread: every position in the square is equally likely.
emi_world.structure.spread.triangular: Triangular spread: positions near the middle of the square are more likely.
emi_world.structure.rings.tooltip: The structures are placed in rings around the world origin (strongholds).
emi_world.structure.rings.count.tooltip: How many structures the rings hold in total, and how many of them are in the innermost ring.
emi_world.structure.rings.distance.toolt: The distance between two rings: %s blocks.
emi_world.structure.biome_tag: The biomes come from the tag #%s
emi_world.structure.loot.tooltip: Click to show the loot of these chests.
